-c "for Tool in wget jq unzip; do if ! command -v \"$Tool\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"$Tool is required but was not found. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; rm -f \"$Dir/updater.zip\"; chmod +x \"$Dir/gtnh-daily-updater\"; echo \"gtnh-daily-updater $Tag installed\";"

-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $Repo = '{{UpdaterRepo}}'; $Want = '{{UpdaterVersion}}'; $Token = '{{GithubToken}}'; $Dir = Join-Path '{{$FullRootDir}}' 'updater'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $Dir | Out-Null; $Headers = @{ 'User-Agent' = 'AMP-gtnh-daily' }; if ($Token -ne '') { $Headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + $Token }; if ($Want -eq '') { $Api = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + $Repo + '/releases/latest' } else { $Api = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + $Repo + '/releases/tags/' + $Want }; try { $Release = Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Headers $Headers -Uri $Api -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output ('Failed to query GitHub releases of ' + $Repo + '. Aborting'); exit 1 }; $Tag = $Release.tag_name; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Tag)) { Write-Output ('No release found in ' + $Repo + '. Aborting'); exit 1 }; $Exe = Join-Path $Dir 'gtnh-daily-updater.exe'; $Installed = ''; if (Test-Path $Exe) { $Out = (& $Exe --version 2>$null) -join ' '; if ($Out -match 'version\s+(\S+)') { $Installed = $Matches[1] } }; if ($Installed -eq $Tag) { Write-Output ('gtnh-daily-updater ' + $Tag + ' already installed. Skipping'); exit 0 }; $Asset = $Release.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -like '*-windows-amd64.zip' } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $Asset) { Write-Output ('Release ' + $Tag + ' of ' + $Repo + ' has no windows-amd64 build. Aborting'; exit 1 }; Expand-Archive -Path $Zip -DestinationPath $Dir -Force; Remove-Item $Zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output ('gtnh-daily-updater ' + $Tag + ' installed');"

-c "for Tool in wget jq unzip; do if ! command -v \"$Tool\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"$Tool is required but was not found. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; echo \"Using GTNH daily build $Tag (config version $Ver)\"; fi; echo \"Downloading GTNH server pack from $Url\"; rm -f base-pack.zip; wget -qO base-pack.zip \"$Url\" || { echo \"Server pack download failed. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; unzip -oq base-pack.zip -d . || { echo \"Failed to extract server pack. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; rm -f base-pack.zip; echo \"$Ver\" > \"$CfgFile\"; echo \"GTNH server pack installed (config version $Ver)\";"

-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; if (Test-Path 'lwjgl3ify-forgePatches.jar') { Write-Output 'Server files already present. Skipping base pack install'; exit 0 }; $Ver = '{{InitialConfigVersion}}'; $Url = '{{BasePackUrl}}'; $CfgFile = Join-Path '{{$FullRootDir}}' 'initial-config.txt'; if ($Url -ne '') { if ($Ver -eq '') { Write-Output 'Base Server Pack URL is set, so Initial Config Version must be set to the config version of that pack. Aborting'; exit 1 }; } elseif ($Ver -match '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$') { $Url = 'https://downloads.gtnewhorizons.com/ServerPacks/GT_New_Horizons_' + $Ver + '_Server_Java_17-25.zip' } elseif ($Ver -ne '') { Write-Output ('Initial Config Version ' + $Ver + ' is not a stable release, so no server pack can be downloaded for it. Aborting'); exit 1 } else { $Tag = '{{DailyBuildTag}}'; $Headers = @{ 'User-Agent' = 'AMP-gtnh-daily' }; if ('{{GithubToken}}' -ne '') { $Headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer {{GithubToken}}' }; if ($Tag -eq '') { $Api = 'https://api.github.com/repos/GTNewHorizons/GTNH-Daily-Builds/releases/latest' } else { $Api = 'https://api.github.com/repos/GTNewHorizons/GTNH-Daily-Builds/releases/tags/' + $Tag.Replace('+', '%2B') }; try { $Release = Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Headers $Headers -Uri $Api -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output ('Failed to query GTNH daily build ' + $Tag + ' (empty = latest). Aborting'; exit 1 }; Remove-Item base-pack.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-Content -Path $CfgFile -Value $Ver -Encoding ASCII; Write-Output ('GTNH server pack installed (config version ' + $Ver + ')');"

-c "U=\"{{$FullRootDir}}updater/gtnh-daily-updater\"; D=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}\"; if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"git is required to merge pack config changes but was not found. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; if [[ ! -x \"$U\" ]]; then echo \"gtnh-daily-updater is missing. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; export GITHUB_TOKEN=\"{{GithubToken}}\"; if [[ ! -f \"${D}.gtnh-daily-updater.json\" ]]; then Cfg=\"{{InitialConfigVersion}}\"; if [[ -z \"$Cfg\" && -f \"{{$FullRootDir}}initial-config.txt\" ]]; then Cfg=$(tr -d \"[:space:]\" < \"{{$FullRootDir}}initial-config.txt\"); fi; if [[ -z \"$Cfg\" ]]; then echo \"Config version of the installed server is unknown. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; echo \"Initializing gtnh-daily-updater (config version $Cfg, mode {{PackMode}})\"; \"$U\" init --instance-dir \"$D\" --side server --mode \"{{PackMode}}\" --config \"$Cfg\" || { echo \"gtnh-daily-updater init failed. -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$U = Join-Path '{{$FullRootDir}}' 'updater\gtnh-daily-updater.exe'; $D = ('{{$FullBaseDir}}').TrimEnd('\', '/'); if ($null -eq (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Output 'git is required to merge pack config changes but was not found. Install Git for Windows. Aborting'; exit 1 }; if (-not (Test-Path $U)) { Write-Output 'gtnh-daily-updater is missing. Aborting'; exit 1 }; $env:GITHUB_TOKEN = '{{GithubToken}}'; $env:GIT_CONFIG_COUNT = '1'; $env:GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0 = 'core.longpaths'; $env:GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0 = 'true'; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $D '.gtnh-daily-updater.json'))) { $Cfg = '{{InitialConfigVersion}}'; $CfgFile = Join-Path '{{$FullRootDir}}' 'initial-config.txt'; if ($Cfg -eq '' -and (Test-Path $CfgFile)) { $Cfg = (Get-Content -Raw $CfgFile).Trim() }; if ($Cfg -eq '') { Write-Output 'Config version of the installed server is unknown. Set Initial Config Version to the exact config version of the uploaded server. Aborting'; exit 1 }; Write-Output ('Initializing gtnh-daily-updater (config version ' + $Cfg + ', mode {{PackMode}})'); & $U init --instance-dir $D --side server --mode '{{PackMode}}' --config $Cfg; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output 'gtnh-daily-updater init failed. Aborting'; exit 1 }; }; $UpdateArgs = @('update', '--instance-dir', $D, '--cache-dir', (Join-Path '{{$FullRootDir}}' 'updater\cache'), '--concurrency', '{{Concurrency}}'); if ('{{ModVersions}}' -eq 'latest') { $UpdateArgs += '--latest' }; if ('{{DailyBuildTag}}' -ne '') { Write-Output 'Updating to daily build {{DailyBuildTag}}'; $UpdateArgs += @('--build', '{{DailyBuildTag}}') }; & $U @UpdateArgs; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output 'gtnh-daily-updater update failed.
